decision: Full car = 'Blobeye Full Car.stl' (2023-07, 23.0M tris, Drive 1-4YmtPLhY5WR5MOA4Rj5O193MN3cgQsC), decimated 4 mm (3.11M tris)
why: Brief's suggested car; densest full scan (Low Poly versions are 2.3M tris). Clean capture: no ground, wheels with spokes and calipers scanned

decision: Canonical frame = Drive 'Front bumper/Aligned for Splitter' frame (car axis-aligned: X width, Y length nose at low Y, Z up); hi-res car moved into it by FPFH+RANSAC+ICP onto 'Blobeye Full Car (Low Poly)' in that folder (p50 1.38 mm, 93% <3 mm); then ive prep (mm->m, centred, floor) -> car4.json; every part prepped --like car4.json
why: The raw car was yawed ~30 deg; the aligned folder already has a level, nose-forward frame (tyre contacts within 2 cm front/rear), so no hand-made levelling transform. One prep transform for all states (lesson: never re-normalise)

decision: Front-end states (all assembled / hood removed / bumper removed / all removed / tabs) share one Artec frame: moved to the car with all_removed->all_removed_1 (0.75 mm) then ONE ICP correction fitted on the hood/fender area only (hood_removed's, 3.6 deg/61 mm), giving 1.8-2.1 mm on all four
why: Bumper area differs between sessions (state scans' bumper/lip is 12-26 mm off the 2023 car's), so fitting on it biased ICP; per-scan fits disagreed, the shared one fits every state (cross-check table in the session)

decision: Separate 'Blobeye Bumper (For Splitter)' part scan NOT used; the front bumper panel is carved from the full car itself (car tris in the bumper box >12 mm from 'bumper removed', largest island only)
why: Part scan is a different bumper/session (p50 6-12 mm off the car's bumper; overlay shows it sitting low and forward). Carving keeps the exploded bumper identical to the car's bumper, so it seats exactly on reassembly

decision: Hood, rear wing and left side skirt carved from the full car the same way (vs 'hood removed'+'GD Scan Engine Bay', 'Rear Wing data' (= wing-off rear, 1.7 mm), 'Sideskirt removed' (2.1 mm)); openings filled with those state scans as captured, each only inside its own box (tools/fill.py) -> base_open
why: Lessons: carve the smallest zone, use state scans as captured over the trimmed car. Per-fill boxes stop e.g. the engine-bay session's different lip leaking into the bumper zone. Contact sheets: chk/bo.jpg shows engine bay, front-mount intercooler and crash structure, filled sill and trunk

decision: GD Scan Engine Bay registered with FPFH+RANSAC onto car front + front states (3/6 tries same pose, fitness 0.24 -> refined p50 1.6 mm; fenders z-fight in the overlay)
why: Only scan with the full engine bay (the front states caught just the radiator support); it is what the hood opening reveals

decision: Not used: GD Sideskirt part (carved skin instead, same reason as bumper), GD Scan Hood (small 30x43 cm hood-scoop fragment), oil cooler/pancake duct/print files/04-05 game model
why: Brief: only our scan data, no CAD/game assets; carved panels guarantee exact seating

decision: Shot plan (Temerario order): s1 low front-right 3/4 turntable -> s2 rear-left 3/4 orbit (wing) -> s3 front wheel extreme close-up (2 mm) -> s4 blobeye headlight crane to hood scoop (2 mm) -> s5 hood opens on its rear hinge over the engine-bay scan -> s6 top-down spin -> s7 exploded view (hood, bumper, wing, left skirt float up, hold, slam home) -> logo
why: Brief order; panels limited to what the state scans support (no trunk-open or door data). Wheel close-up works here because this scan captured spokes and calipers

decision: Framing after three 30% preview passes: turntables aim 0.55 m toward the featured end (r 5.3-5.6 m, 30 mm); hood shot r 3.0-3.5 m; top-down 6.4-7.2 m; exploded parts stack ABOVE the car (hood +1.35 m, bumper +0.8 m, wing +0.8 m, skirt out 0.5 m/up 0.35 m), camera front-left high
why: Sheet 1: s1/s2 swung into side profiles and cropped the near end, top-down/hood/explode read small; sheet 2: bumper flew out of the 9:16 frame. Temerario ref floats panels above the car (portrait-friendly); lesson: keep parts from flying at the lens

decision: Music = original eurobeat-inspired track generated for this reel by the coordinating session (Higgsfield/ElevenLabs), 40.05 s file; grid 152.00 BPM, beat 0.39473 s, t0 0.06 s (tools/music_grid.py)
why: Brief: use only the parent's track. ive beats onsets sit ~45 ms early (1.184 vs hat click 1.22 / kick rise 1.24 in the 20 ms band envelopes) - lesson: anchor on the kick, not the first flux onset

decision: Cuts on bar lines (4 beats from t0): 4.80 | 7.95 | 9.53 | 11.11 | 12.69 | 17.43 | 22.17 | logo 34.80; explode separates on bar 16 (25.32 s) and locks on bar 21 (33.22 s); video ends 39.30 s
why: Per-bar band energies: bass is constant (rolling eurobeat bass, no kick drop to cut on); the lifts are brightness steps at bars 3 (4.80), 8 (12.69, hood opens on it) and 16 (25.32, brightest bar -> separation); final hit 37.95 s, RMS halves at 38.37, silent by ~39.3 s (track file runs to 40.05). Holds vary 1/2/3/8 bars per lesson

decision: Added s8 wing + tail-light close-up (2 mm rear half) as the third 1-bar close-up; framed high so the licence plate stays out of frame
why: Rear wing is the blobeye STI's signature; first framing showed the plate legibly - no real-world identifiers in the reel

decision: All shots rendered at -0.5 EV (tools/shot.py = lexus-is300's copy of the ferrari-296 renderer with an exposure field); finals restarted
why: 0 EV s1 frames: car median 205-208, p90 241-247, 4-8 % clipped on the roof vs Temerario ref ~200/231; huracan and lexus sessions measured the same and chose -0.5 EV

decision: Exploded bumper path: forward 0.32 m first, then up to its float spot; same dog-leg on the way home (forward of the nose, then straight back to lock)
why: Headlights stay on the car (they are not in the bumper panel); a straight-up path would pass the bumper's top lip through them

decision: Rear licence plate flattened in the full-car mesh (tools/deplate.py, copy of infiniti-g35's: emboss projected onto the plate plane inside the recess box, 12 mm band) -> car4_dp.blend prepped --like car4.json; s2 re-rendered
why: Looked at s2 final frame 1 at full res: the scanned plate characters were readable. Box found from a depth map of the recess (plate face y 2.15 m vs bumper 2.18-2.19 m). Front plate is blank on this car

decision: Assembly: clips slowed 2.7-9.8 % via src_fps = (N-1)/(dur + 3 frames) (explode kept at 15 so its separation/lock stay on bars 16/21); v3 delivered
why: v1 frame diffs showed 3 exact-duplicate frames before every cut (N frames at 15 fps carry only (N-1)/15 s of motion and minterpolate drops ~2 tail frames, so the assembler cloned the last frame) - a visible stutter on the close-ups (diff 5-8 -> 0). v3: only the assembler's own 1-frame cut hold remains

decision: Delivered v3 checks: 1178 frames 1080x1920 30 fps yuv420p, AAC 44.1k, moov before mdat; cuts at frames 144/239/286/333/381/523/665/1044 measured from frame diffs, max 12 ms from the kick grid; music RMS at 39.2 s = 24 (silent), video ends 39.27 s
why: Rubric 2/8/9 verified on the delivered file, not the yaml

decision: Accepted for v1: full-car shots hold the car at ~55-60 % of frame width; during the explode float the bumper is cropped by the left edge
why: Re-rendering the 190-frame explode costs ~40 min; flagged in review.md as the first fix if the reviewer wants it tighter (pull the bumper float to x +0.3 m or start the orbit at 45 deg)

decision: Lighting-dropout check on all v1 renders (tools/lumacheck.py, per-frame mean luma vs neighbour median): no dropouts (worst ratio 0.93, s2 orbit). v2 renderer defaults persistent data OFF
why: V2 brief + lessons: Cycles persistent data drops lights mid-animation on keyed parts in sibling reels

decision: v2 structure (direction.md, scene-director pass): rear opener (reused v1 s2, whole car, moving) -> wing lifts off on bar 3 over the wing-off trunk scan -> left skirt drops off over the 'sideskirt removed' sill -> front-left wheel -> hood LIFTS OFF on bar 9 into a held descent over the engine-bay scan -> front bumper removed HERO, intercooler revealed on bar 16 (25.32 s) with labels -> exploded state (high left) -> reassembly, last lock bar 21, fade -> small logo
why: User v2 notes + addendum: order by this car's scan features, travel one way (rear->side->front, front = richest region gets the brightest bar), one section per sequence, part off -> stay on that section, bumper-removed data as the hero, no wasted rotations, whole car at the open, short ending + small logo

decision: Hood now lifts off (translate) instead of hinging open; v1 s5 dropped
why: Addendum D: never fake an opening by animating the closed scan - our data is a 'hood removed' state + engine-bay scan, not a hood-open scan

decision: Removed parts park stacked above the car (hood +2.0 m, wing +2.05 m, bumper forward 0.7/up 1.3 m) and the skirt drops out/down (+0.70 x, -0.30 z); every later shot keeps them parked
why: Previews: parking beside the car put the bumper at the lens in the finale and parked parts clipped the top edge of the front shots; stacking above is the Temerario layout and keeps them out of the front close-ups. Progressive state: a removed part never reappears attached

decision: Dropped v1 shots: s1 front turntable, s3 right wheel, s4 headlight/scoop crane, s8 wing close-up (merged into S2), s5 hinge hood, s6 rotating top-down, s7 all-at-once explode
why: ive director flagged s1~s2, s4~s8, s4~s5 as repeated views and 4.3 s dead in s7; user: no wasted rotations, one sequence per section, never separate every part at once in one wide orbit

decision: base_open de-plated too (base_open_dp.blend, prepped --like car4.json)
why: First v2 preview of the wing shot showed the plate legible - the open base was built from the un-plated car

decision: S6 frames 1-57: parked wing (floating alone in black, clipped at the top edge) painted back to background (tools/mask_top.py -> S6_bumper_m); luma check OK
why: Addendum A: nothing clipped at frame edges. The wing is separated from the car by >270 px of empty black in those frames, so masking changes nothing else; a 50-min re-render for it was not worth it. Next time: park parts out of the low front cameras' view

decision: S3_skirt re-framed (camera 1.0 m high looking down at the sill, skirt drops to z -0.95 out of frame) and re-queued
why: Final contact sheet (first/mid/last): lower half of the frame was black and the parked skirt sat in it as a stray sliver - addendum A: detail shots fill the frame with the section, no dead black

decision: S3 camera raised again (target z 0.80) so the doors fill the top 70% and the bare sill sits in the lower third; S7a orbit r 9.0->8.7 centred further back, S7b start r 8.6->7.8
why: Final/preview contact sheets: S7a cluster filled ~65% width with the hood and car tail clipped at the right edge after a first tighten; S7b first frame had the bumper touching the left edge. Addendum A: wide shots whole car with margins, nothing clipped
